main_text.head: M. TVL. CICERONIS LAELIVS, SIVE DE AMICITIA dialogus ad T. Pomponium Atticum. Praefatio.
main_text.p: VINTVS Mutius Augur, Scævola multa narrare de C. Lelio socero suo memoriter, & jucundè solebat, nec dubitare illum in omni sermone appellare sapientem. Ego autem à patre ita erâ deductus ad Scævolam sumpta virili toga, ut quoad posfem, & liceret à senis latere nunquam discederem. Itaque multa ab eo prudenter disputata, multa etiam breviter & commodè dicta memoriæ mandabam, fierique studebam eius prudentia doctior. Quo mortuo me ad pontificem Scævolâ contuli, quem unum nostræ civitatis & ingenio & industria

page.notes: The title block is set in large roman capitals with italic subtitle; the woodcut initial "V" is joined to "INTVS" (printed as "VINTVS"). Printed as "VINTVS", the "V" of the initial is the woodcut letter; the word is "Vintus" in the scan, transcribed as printed. Words at the line ends are not hyphenated in the scan, so none are marked. Text reads "Scævola" and "Scævolam" with æ as printed. The "B" at the foot is a signature mark. Title ornament and border are not text. Long s is plain s throughout. Page number "1" is printed at the upper right corner. The running head is absent. No catchword is visible. The text has a small deterioration at "discederem" and "dicta memoriæ"; readings are as printed.
